prompt: 我在 /home/maxime/workspace 這個目錄下已經有 kde.env 了。幫我建立一個叫 staging 的 Kind 環境，然後把 https://github.com/myorg/api-service.git 的 main branch 部署上去，project 名稱叫 api-service。請直接執行所有需要的 kde 指令。

assertions.text: Uses `kde start staging` or `kde create staging` to create the environment
Uses `kind` as the environment type (explicitly or by default)
Uses `kde proj create api-service` to create the project
Uses `kde proj fetch api-service` with the correct git URL and branch
Uses `kde proj deploy api-service` or `kde proj pipeline api-service` to deploy
Does NOT fabricate non-existent kde commands or flags
